description: This file, view.metadata.php, defines a PHP class 'ViewMetadata' that provides methods for rendering various HTML form elements (checkboxes, select boxes, text inputs), as well as a display method that generates a web interface for exploring Vardefs, module attributes, and relationships within the SuiteCRM project. It also references another class 'VardefBrowser' which contains static methods to retrieve and filter module definitions and field attributes from the global vardef data structures.

classes.name: ViewMetadata
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering an interactive form and display interface for exploring module and field definitions within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: VardefBrowser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve and filter module vardefs and field attributes from the global definitions.

methods.name: displayCheckBoxes
methods.description: Renders a set of checkboxes for given values, marking those in the selected array as checked.

methods.name: displaySelect
methods.description: Renders a select dropdown element with options and a specified selected value.

methods.name: displayTextBoxes
methods.description: Renders a set of text inputs for specified values, pre-filling values from POST if available.

methods.name: printValue
methods.description: Prints the value in a formatted way using print_r inside <pre> tags.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that renders the web form and handles user interactions to explore module vardefs, attributes, fields, and relationships.
